data.name: Shell
data.description: Shell is a global oil, gas and energy major headquartered in London that is developing DAC technology as one of several carbon management activities adjacent to its core hydrocarbon business. It operates a proprietary solid-sorbent DAC demonstration unit at Shell Technology Center Houston and, via Shell US Gas & Power, acts as technical delivery partner for the DOE-funded Pelican Gulf Coast DAC Hub in Louisiana alongside Mitsubishi, LSU, UH, RepAir Carbon and Origen. Shell Ventures also invests in DAC startups (Avnos, RepAir).
